text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: sturgeon.ai (single-tenant) streaming p99 latency breached 2.8s (SLO 1.2s). Error rate stable, but streaming stalls and many short reconnects detected. Auto-page to on-call.

Jamie (on-call): paging — taking. I’m looking at the console now, linking dashboards.

Leila: quick snapshot: p95 ~ 820ms, p99 ~ 2.8s right now. Streaming throughput up 3x for the last 6 minutes. Most affected region: us-west-2.

TomR: timeline: around 4422223000 we saw a burst of ~9k concurrent streams from sturgeon.ai auth token set. Many sessions are short (~3–6s) then reconnect. That pattern spikes overhead — handshake + cold KV cache.

Raj: can we confirm if these are new client versions? CS?

Ana-CS: pinged Sturgeon support, they report a deploy at 14:07 PDT pushing a new batching proxy that retries connections aggressively. They suspect a bug. They're rolling it back as we speak.

Jamie (on-call): good. mitigation plan: 1) add temporary ingress throttle for sturgeon tenant 2) route new streams to fallback model variant with smaller KV warmup 3) raise pool size for that tenant for 10m

Maya (infra): /run scale pool sturgeon-pool +3 (will do) — stepping up capacity now, ETA 45s.

eng-runtime-bot: Request accepted: scaled sturgeon-pool from 4 -> 7 nodes.

Leila: after scaling started p99 dropped to 1.6s but then back to ~2.1s when reconnect storm resumed.

TomR: logs show many short-lived sessions causing repeated KV cache population for the same heavy prefixes — not traditional long-prefix thrash but frequent full-cache rebuilds due to reconnects. Snippet: ```WARN session=xyz reconnect after 2.8s; kv_populate_ms=490; first_token_latency_ms=380```

Jamie (on-call): can we enable per-tenant short-session throttling? Prefer soft 5-reqs/sec limit for streams and small token-burst window.

Maya (infra): can implement a temporary rate-limit rule at the edge for tenant sturgeon.ai — applying now with a low-impact skew.

Maya (infra): applied rule: `edge.rate_limit.tenant: sturgeon.ai, unit=stream, value=5/s, burst=10`. Monitoring for errors.

Ana-CS: Sturgeon rollback completed — they saw immediate reduction in reconnects on their side. They’re keeping rollback while we monitor.

Leila: metrics after rollback + edge throttle: p99 ~ 1.05s, p95 ~ 610ms. Streaming stalls reduced by 85%.

TomR: still see a tail cluster of sessions with repeated tiny reconnects from a handful of IP blocks. I’ve blackholed 3 suspicious IPs at the LB.

Jamie (on-call): thanks. Next steps: keep throttle for 15m, keep scaled pool until traffic normalizes, follow-up ticket to add automatic detection for reconnect storms (rule: >X reconnects per minute per token -> flag).

Raj: created ticket #INC-5482: "detect/mitigate tenant reconnect storms" and assigned to eng-runtime with P1 label for 72h remediation.

TomR: adding a short-term runtime tweak: reduce KV prefill window for short sessions so repeated reconnects waste less work. Will ship small config change to canary pool now.

eng-runtime-bot: rolled config `kv_prefill.ms=150` to 2/7 nodes in sturgeon-pool (canary).

Leila: canary looks good — first_token latency improved for canary to ~220ms vs 380ms baseline.

Ana-CS: customer confirms rollback + our throttle fixed their immediate user-facing lag. They asked for a postmortem and guidance for their proxy retry strategy.

Jamie (on-call): excellent. I'll keep monitoring until last_message_ts. When we’re stable we should do a short postmortem with CS + runtime + infra: root cause appears to be client-side aggressive reconnects causing repeated KV cache work + inefficient short-session handling.

Raj: leaving follow-ups: INC-5482 (detection + automated throttle), ENG-7623 (runtime changes for short-session efficiency), CS-1991 (customer remediation guidance).

Maya (infra): removing temporary blackholes on IPs; LB rules restored. Throttle still active for now.

Jamie (on-call): marking incident as "mitigated" for now. Will hand off to Leila for post-incident triage docs. :white_check_mark:

Leila: will prepare summary + timeline + dashboards and ping sturgeon for a joint RCA session tomorrow.

incident-bot: Incident update: mitigated -> monitoring. Assigned: Leila, TomR, Raj.

Jamie (on-call): handing off. I'm available if it re-escalates.
